extras.name: TranslateGemma 27B on README tables: 'N of M' counts and product names slip; the cache brings a slip back
extras.note: VERIFIED against ai-jam-sessions' commits, re-read 2026-10-20. Translating that repo's README locally with google/translategemma-27b-it through polyglot-mcp: in Chinese, a table cell read reversed, '224 of 218' (218 首中的 224 首) for 218 of 224, and '285 of 414' came back as an ordinal, 'the 285th of 414' (414个中的第285个), held in the translation cache; both were corrected by hand (commit 5f8d1e2, the README.zh.md diff and the cache at that commit). In Hindi, the model name 'Kimi-K3' was transliterated into Devanagari (किमी-के3); it was restored by hand in e4cd2fb and came back on the next run from the cache, to be corrected again in 5f8d1e2. Prose was not the problem; counts written as 'N of M' and product or model names were. Check: compare verbatim English lines before and after, read every 'N of M' cell, and clear a hand-fixed entry from the polyglot cache so it doesn't return. Whether the pattern holds beyond this README is untested.
